reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact material system (W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf), intervention (Hf addition), mechanism (nanoprecipitates as defect sinks), and predicted outcome (reduced defect accumulation and hardening) that were already designed, synthesized, and experimentally demonstrated in the 2023 paper (P1, P2, P24). The proposed test is essentially a replication of the study already reported in that paper, with no new alloy, regime, or mechanistic insight.
